description: React component for a map view popover content, allowing users to adjust zoom, latitude, and longitude settings with save and close actions.

classes.name: MapViewPopoverContent
classes.description: React functional component for map view configuration popover.

methods.name: onCloseClick
methods.description: Handles closing the popover, resets form state, and calls onClose callback.

methods.name: onSaveClick
methods.description: Triggers save callback with current map view configuration.

methods.name: onZoomChange
methods.description: Updates the zoom level in the map view configuration.

methods.name: onLatitudeChange
methods.description: Updates the latitude in the map view configuration.

methods.name: onLongitudeChange
methods.description: Updates the longitude in the map view configuration.
